title: Simply Indispensable
body: This was actually a bit of an “accidental” purchase. I downloaded Owll on the App Store on a trial basis, tried it once and forgot about it before the full year subscription went live. “Oh great was my original thought. I just paid money for something I won’t use.” I thought about complaining to the company, but I figured, “Well I might as well give this thing a try.” My first project was to ingest a YouTube video of a company’s keynote session - 90 seconds later I had a full summary. “Huh, maybe this is worthwhile software” I thought. I then used the instant recording for an interview that I held with a candidate. I used the summary to fill out the Greenhouse HR notes, again saving me a lot of time. I then took it to my doctor to summarize his advice to me. Finally, and this is my primary use case, I use it to summarize investor conference calls, saving my company about $30,000 per year for services that do that for you. The conclusion, Owll is a multi-function tool that I use several times a week - and it’s worth every penny.
